definitions.explanation: Strong and courageous in a way traditionally admired in men. A written, somewhat literary word, used of bearing, conduct and figures in stories more than of people one knows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雄々|おお}しく⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雄々|おお}しかった。
examples.english: The ship pressing on through the storm was a heroic sight.

notes:
Also written {雄雄|おお}しい. Formal and literary; in conversation ⟦{男|おとこ}らしい→男らしい：15549_otokorashii⟧ or ⟦{勇|いさ}ましい→勇ましい：11847_isamashii⟧ is more usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄々|おお}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: a heroic figure
- {雄々|おお}しく⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to face something bravely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧らしい: manly; the everyday word, about a man behaving as a man is expected to
- ⟦{勇|いさ}ましい→勇ましい：11847_isamashii⟧: brave, gallant; not tied to men, and also said of music or speeches
- ⟦{女々|めめ}しい→女々しい：33176_memeshii⟧: effeminate, unmanly; the opposite, and a criticism
